pick.name: Provider-native structured outputs + Zod (TS) / Pydantic (Python)
pick.what: Schema-constrained JSON: Claude output_config.format (GA; zodOutputFormat / messages.parse with Pydantic) and AI SDK object output
pick.why: Constrained decoding makes retries unnecessary; no extra dependency beyond Zod/Pydantic; HIPAA/ZDR eligible
pick.free_limits: Limits: no recursive schemas, no min/max or length constraints, 20 strict tools/request; schema cached 24h so no regulated data in schema names/enums
pick.install: npm i zod  |  pip install pydantic

alts.name: Instructor
alts.what: Pydantic-based extraction with retries across 15+ providers
alts.why: For multi-provider Python extraction or providers without native schema output

alts.name: Outlines
alts.what: Constrained generation for local models (JSON schema, regex, grammar)

candidates.name: Native structured output + Zod/Pydantic
candidates.verdict: Pick: zero extra deps, constrained decoding

candidates.name: Pydantic AI output types
candidates.verdict: Same idea inside the agent framework

decision: Define schemas once in Zod/Pydantic and let the provider enforce them; add Instructor only for models lacking native schema output; use Outlines/GBNF for local and on-device models.
details: Instructor demoted: native support removed its main advantage on Claude/Gemini.
